arguments.text: Plan (1 min): 10 km, 1000 m legs. Pace off the POD (shaft power vs sustainable_shaft_power_w, w_bal_pod_frac), not boat-speed reserve (that blames current/drag on paddler). Watches set: pod_reserve_low, drag_suspect (push_local well below push_along = weed on rudder? consider clear_rudder), over_sustainable / under_sustainable (shaft vs sustainable, after 4 min, 90 s), finish_reserve (<1.5 km and pod reserve >30 pct). Start hard (276 W shaft vs CP 208); let them settle by ~3-4 min before cueing. CP may be 10-25 pct off: check cp_implied / fade later.

arguments.text: 7 min: paddler settled ~222 W shaft (sustainable 211), pod reserve 44 pct falling ~3.5 pct/min, would empty ~1.7 km on. Paddler says 6/10 feels fine (may be underestimating, or CP may be low by 10 pct+). No fade yet (-0.4 pct). Cued ease to 2:34 (154 s/500 ground, ~213 W). Tightened over_sustainable watch to +10 W for 2 min. Next: if they hold target and reserve still drops, ease more; if reserve stops dropping at ~215 W with no fade, CP may be higher: consider set_critical_power.

arguments.text: 13 min: after 2:36 cue shaft fell 216->204 W (followed). Pod reserve steady 28 pct (below CP now, refilling). Boat reserve 10 pct and falling = MISLEADING: push_local is about +0.06 on north legs (1,3) and -0.04 on south leg 2, while fitted push_along reads ~0, so a ~0.05 m/s north-going current inflates boat speed/power on north legs. Trust pod. Check after turn at 3000 m: push_local should go negative on leg 4 (south); if it stays positive at low shaft power, suspect pod reading low (drift). Paddler 7/10 steady. No fade (0 to -0.8).

Pod reserve now 18 pct, shaft 216 vs sustainable 210. Cued ease 2:35 (155). Lesson: paddler drifts back to ~220 W within ~5 min of an ease cue; re-cue when shaft > sustainable +6 (watch tightened). Ground pace targets make them push in counter-current patches.
